purpose: 12-question A-F diagnostic grading a firm's Robinhood Chain adoption fit across four paths: stock-token application, collateral/lending venue, index/basket product, and agent-settlement automation. Routes to the reconciliation, regime-mapping, valuation-lint, collateral-haircut, BoLD-finality, and AP-redemption-stress workflows. Deliberately does not reuse the MiCA/GENIUS question set from the Tempo and Arc diagnostics, since Robinhood Chain stock tokens sit in the opposite regulatory carve-out. Zero network, zero PII.
